blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built from Muse's presale list (2026-11-01). Prices appear only where the source dates them within three months. Paragon presale data is still to be merged, and projects sold through private channels may be missing.

Presale means you buy a home before it is built, and you take possession when it completes. This page lists every Abbotsford presale project on my list that is scheduled to complete between 2027 and 2028, with the developer, type, size and deposit where the sources publish them.
Abbotsford presale projects at a glance

The list holds 8 presale projects in Abbotsford with estimated completion between 2027 and 2028: 6 in 2027, 2 in 2028. By type, that is 5 condo projects, 1 townhome project, 1 mixed condo and townhome project, 1 duplex project.

3 of the 8 have a price published and dated within the last three months. The lowest published starting price is at Sage (Sage 3 currently marketed): from $314,900. For the other 5, the price is either not published or the price I have is too old to show, so ask me for the current list.
A deposit structure is published for 8 of the 8.
Developers with more than one project here: Diverse Properties (2).
The largest project with a confirmed home count is Sage (Sage 3 currently marketed) at 455 homes.
